invariant: same .rva + same viewport + same spec version + same resolver profile = same ResolvedScene

open.description: Parse and integrity-validate a .rva package. Normative.

resolve.description: Deterministic scene of absolute element geometry. Normative; identical across runtimes.

resource.description: Raw resource bytes for a declared id. Normative.

has_resource.description: Whether a declared resource id exists. Normative.

convenience.relative_for: NON-NORMATIVE. Filename/MIME helper. Not a fundamental RVA operation; may be folded into resolve metadata or removed before the public contract is frozen.
convenience.render_png: NON-NORMATIVE. Reference rasterization (resvg) for CLI/server/RN convenience. Conformance does not require PNG support.

rendererResponsibility: Draw the ResolvedScene with the platform graphics stack. Glyph rasterization and pixels may differ; resolution semantics must not.
typography: Resolution uses a deterministic, platform-independent advance model (see spec/overview.md). System fonts affect rendering only.
